answer1: View fictional products and transactions, submit and track requests, and simulate a handoff. Changes persist in the local database.
help2: Is Nexqori connected to my bank?
answer2: This demo has working login and permissions on its local server. Banking data and operations are simulated; the assistant uses rules with no connected AI model.
answer3: Conversations, requests and language preferences are stored per user in local PostgreSQL. Do not enter real banking data. Sign out when finished.
adminNote: Administrator access. Banking operations remain simulated.
